::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 584,156 people lived in County Cork, up 7.6% on 2016. It had the second largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 68% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Cork was €1,542, the 6th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
